purpose: Reproducibility of the r0 1.0 contact trace: exact replicate of 2026-11-27/r1/lab-vernier/001 (A-A at rest, horizontal, (4.5,5.0) and (5.5,5.0), T = 0.6, sample_dt 0.0003).
